data.one_liner: Dart DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) client supporting multiple providers and record types
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart implementation of DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) supporting Google, Cloudflare, AdGuard, NextDNS, Quad9, and OpenDNS. It resolves hostnames to IP addresses, supports 36 DNS record types, and includes wire format and privacy protection features.
use_when: You need to perform DNS lookups via HTTPS in a Dart or Flutter application
You want to use specific DNS providers like Cloudflare, Google, AdGuard, or Quad9
You need to query specific DNS record types such as MX, TXT, SRV, or HTTPS
avoid_when: You rely entirely on the platform's standard built-in DNS resolution without custom DoH requirements
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of 36 DNS record types
Includes privacy features and error handling
